config.external_score: Native ResultEntry.Confidence; thresholds selected using calibration unknowns only

protocol.unknown_policy: Exclude target from gallery and exclude crops overlapping another gallery source
protocol.threshold_selection: Calibration only; choose smallest score with empirical unknown FPR <= 0.01; show held-out FPR with numerator/denominator and uncertainty
protocol.primary_task: Adapted centered annotated-chunk content identification, not native PEX segment detection

latency_note: Native normalization/fingerprint/hash extraction plus matching; FFmpeg decode separately recorded

precision_provenance.operation: Round native ResultEntry.Confidence to 12 decimal places for calibration and acceptance; preserve raw_score
precision_provenance.reason: Mathematically identical one-fingerprint coverage can differ by about 1e-14 from floating-point subtraction; tied evidence must not be split by numerical jitter
